hero.title: Business Management in Sweden for Indian Students
paras: **Business Management in Sweden** is an attractive study option for students who want to develop skills in leadership, marketing, finance, entrepreneurship, international business and organisational strategy. Swedish universities combine academic learning with practical assignments, teamwork, case studies and business-oriented projects.

overview: Students can choose a bachelor's degree after completing their secondary education or pursue a master's degree after obtaining a recognised undergraduate qualification. Programme titles may vary between institutions and can include Business and Economics, International Business Management, Business and Management, or Management.
Through **Edu Hawk worldwide study abroad guidance**, students can explore suitable programmes and understand the requirements involved in pursuing higher education in Sweden.

universities.name: \. University of Gothenburg
universities.desc: The University of Gothenburg offers a **Bachelor of Science in Business and Economics** and a **Master of Science in Management**. The master's programme is taught in English and is listed for Autumn 2027\. **Master's tuition fee:** SEK 194,000 for the complete programme for fee-paying students. **![][image1]**

universities.name: \. Stockholm School of Economics
universities.desc: The Stockholm School of Economics offers a three-year **Bachelor's Programme in Business and Economics**, taught entirely in English. It provides a foundation in business, economics, finance, innovation and entrepreneurship. * **![][image2]**

universities.name: \. Mälardalen University
universities.desc: Mälardalen University offers an English-taught **Bachelor's Programme in International Business Management**, focusing on business administration in an international context. **![][image3]** Students comparing the **Best Universities for Business Management in Sweden** should check the exact degree title, programme language, specialisations, tuition fees and admission requirements for their intended intake.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Business Management in Sweden?
items.a: Yes, Indian students with qualifying credentials meeting English language proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL) and academic prerequisites can apply to recognized universities in Sweden.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Business Management in Sweden?
items.a: Most master's and international bachelor's degree programmes are taught entirely in English for international students across Swedish universities.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Business Management in Sweden?
items.a: Tuition fees for international students generally range between SEK 80,000 and SEK 150,000 per year, depending on the institution and level of study.

items.q: Can international students work while studying in Sweden?
items.a: Yes, non-EU international students holding a valid Swedish residence permit for higher education are permitted to work alongside their studies without a fixed hours limitation during term time.
